sharedConstraints: Use the supplied portraits only for the warm polished Palari 3D finish. Create original teaching characters; do not copy identities, garments, hairstyles, or accessories. Avoid stereotypes, regional face types, photorealism, logos, and watermarks.

plates.title: Portrait DNA and silhouette
plates.alt: Palari portrait construction study with front and profile views, construction guides, and a progression from simple head planes to a finished portrait.
plates.prompt: Create a visual-development plate explaining the Palari square portrait, skull, face, neck, shoulders, profile, and construction progression on warm cream paper.

plates.title: Eye, eyelid, and brow construction
plates.alt: A comparative Palari eye and eyebrow study showing lid structures, spacing, brow rhythms, gaze, and varied faces.
plates.prompt: Create an artist-facing Palari eye and brow study covering lids, sockets, gaze, catchlights, spacing, and varied individual construction.

plates.title: Nose and mouth mechanics
plates.alt: Palari studies of varied noses, lips, smiles, facial hair, and age-related mouth and nose construction.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari visual guide to varied nose bridges, tips, nostrils, lips, smiles, teeth grouping, facial hair, and age.

plates.title: Hair architecture and texture
plates.alt: A broad Palari hair study showing silhouettes, construction stages, edge details, curls, waves, braids, locs, and varied hairstyles.
plates.prompt: Create a comprehensive Palari hair construction plate from skull and silhouette through primary masses, secondary clumps, and selective strands.

plates.title: Headwear, facial hair, and accessories
plates.alt: Palari headwear, glasses, jewelry, and facial-hair construction studies with varied original characters.
plates.prompt: Create respectful Palari construction studies for headwear, glasses, earrings, necklaces, beards, and mustaches.

plates.title: Face shape, age, and variation
plates.alt: Many distinct Palari faces and graphite constructions demonstrating age, jaw, cheek, eye, nose, and silhouette variation.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari face variation sheet using distinct skulls, jaws, cheeks, feature spacing, ages, and silhouettes rather than one default face.

plates.title: Garments, shoulders, and boundaries
plates.alt: Palari neckline, collar, shoulder, garment, and hair-overlap studies for clean portrait construction.
plates.prompt: Create Palari garment and shoulder studies showing complete shoulders, neckline authority, fabric thickness, folds, layering, and hair overlap.

plates.title: Light, color, and materials
plates.alt: A Palari rendering progression with material swatches for skin, fabric, hair, glass, metal, and headwear.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari lighting and material plate showing the path from flat color to soft studio render and distinct skin, fabric, hair, glass, and metal response.

plates.title: Expression, composition, and polish
plates.alt: One Palari character demonstrating varied natural expressions, composition checks, and polish comparisons.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari expression and final-polish plate with natural acting, subtle asymmetry, silhouette checks, and works-versus-avoid examples.

plates.title: Profile and rotation
plates.alt: A Palari character turnaround from front to back with head-construction guides and upward and downward views.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari front, three-quarter, profile, rear, up, and down head-rotation plate with consistent identity and guides.

plates.title: Facial planes and sculpt construction
plates.alt: Neutral-clay Palari sculpt studies showing facial planes, component parts, material spheres, and expression shapes.
plates.prompt: Create a neutral-clay Palari facial-plane and sculpt-construction reference with part separation, surface flow, and a compact expression set.

plates.title: Expression transitions
plates.alt: One Palari identity moving through coordinated expressions with detailed studies of eyes and mouths.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari expression-transition plate preserving identity while lids, brows, cheeks, nostrils, mouth, and jaw move together.

plates.title: Hair detail and edge architecture
plates.alt: Palari hair silhouettes and progressive edge-detail studies across straight, wavy, curly, coily, braided, loc, and covered hair.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari hair edge-architecture plate with silhouette, primary masses, overlapping clumps, selective strands, and controlled flyaways.

plates.title: Palette and background harmony
plates.alt: Six Palari palette studies and one character tested against several value and background systems.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari five-part palette and background-harmony plate preserving boundaries across light, mid-value, warm, and cool settings.

plates.title: Headwear folds and fabric mechanics
plates.alt: Respectful Palari headwear studies showing folds, wrap direction, anchor points, fabric texture, and head construction.
plates.prompt: Create respectful Palari headwear studies showing the skull, anchor points, tension, compression, overlap, thickness, gravity, and material differences.

plates.title: 3D orthographic turnaround
plates.alt: A neutral Palari bust shown consistently from front, three-quarter, profile, rear three-quarter, and back views.
plates.prompt: Create a production-oriented Palari orthographic bust turnaround with locked camera height, scale, head tilt, shoulders, hair volume, and landmarks.

plates.title: 3D sculpt, materials, and rig language
plates.alt: A neutral-clay Palari head with component parts, facial deformation studies, material spheres, and a final color render.
plates.prompt: Create a Palari 3D production plate covering neutral sculpt, separate parts, materials, facial deformation flow, and a compact rig expression set.

plates.title: People, not presets
plates.alt: Six structurally distinct original Palari individuals paired with neutral construction busts.
plates.prompt: Create a text-free board of six original Palari individuals with distinct eyelids, spacing, brows, noses, cheeks, jaws, ages, skin tones, and hair, each paired with a neutral construction bust. Show individual variation without regions or demographic types.

plates.title: Shared emotion, individual anatomy
plates.alt: Four distinct Palari individuals each moving from neutral to a gentle smile while retaining identity.
plates.prompt: Create a text-free four-row expression study. Each distinct Palari individual moves from neutral through softening to gentle smile while identity, anatomy, age, hair, skin, clothing, camera, and lighting remain locked.

plates.title: Masks, recoloring, and final QA
plates.alt: One curly-haired Palari portrait with four safe background and garment color variations plus monochrome protection-region studies.
plates.prompt: Create a text-free safe-recolor QA board with one complex curly-haired Palari identity, four variants changing only background and upper garment, and simple monochrome studies for foreground, hair, neck and skin, and garment regions.
